# Assets · Vectors

16 files under `assets/Vectors/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

## Usage notes

# Vectors

Original Trash Polka and isometric artwork for heroes, headers, edges and transitions. Grunge stays strongest around hero art and edges, never behind controls, tables or reading text.

**Trash Polka** (ink `#151519`, crimson `#A0112B` / `#B8143E`): `brush-slash`, `brush-stroke`, `splatter-ink`, `splatter-crimson`, `ink-drips`, `halftone-fade`, `torn-edge`, `enso-ring`.

**Isometric / HUD** (ink lines, one crimson element): `iso-cube`, `iso-grid`, `hex-cluster`, `hud-ring`, `target-reticle`, `circuit-trace`, `coordinate-ruler`, `laser-lines` (`accent-electric`, decorative only).

Rules: at most three vectors per composition, one of them crimson. Behind text, put a verified readable surface (`overlay-glass` or a solid panel) between art and copy. All files are flat SVG — recolour by editing fills; no external references, safe offline.
